summary: Orthodoxos & Misos is a family-run packaging house in Xylofagou, Larnaca, Cyprus, that washes, peels and cuts potatoes and other vegetables for hotels, restaurants, caterers and shops in Cyprus, and exports whole fresh Cypriot potatoes. The packaging house has operated since 2016; the family has exported Cypriot potatoes since 1987.
founded: 2016 (packaging house; family has exported Cypriot potatoes since 1987)
products: Washed jacket potatoes and whole peeled potatoes
Chips (French fries) and steak house potatoes
Easy Cooking ready-to-cook potatoes for retail
Whole fresh Cypriot potatoes for export
markets: Hotels, restaurants and catering businesses across Cyprus
Professional kitchens and shops in Cyprus
Fresh-cut vegetables for the Cyprus market only
Importers and wholesalers abroad (whole fresh potatoes)
facts: Fresh-cut potatoes vacuum-packed in 5 kg or 6 kg packs, depending on the product
Stated storage temperature for HO.RE.CA. products: 4–7°C
Easy Cooking potatoes: stated storage temperature 2–6°C
Started exporting under its own name in 2026
limitations: Processing capacity, facility size and staff numbers are not published on the pages read.
